what: HIGH (code audit CA-A01-006, MEASURED): A multi-leg package's close verdict is effectuated only against legs[0] (the linked leg) each tick, so if that leg's close fails, is wedge-suppressed, or is in IB cooldown, every sibling leg (e.g. the bybit_portfolio / alpaca_portfolio real-money mirror) is never closed for as long as the head leg stays stuck. LOCATION: src/runtime/order_monitor.py:954-1178. PROPOSED FIX: Iterate legs and pick the first leg that is NOT suppressed/cooling/known-failing this tick (or advance a per-package cursor on failure); keep one exchange close per tick if needed for the IB socket constraint.
